data_note: 30-symbol DST-safe 4H surrogate; 2024-2025 discovery, 2026 holdout; 215-bar warmup; not canonical 131-symbol PIT

definitions.ALMA: Arnaud Legoux MA 20/40, offset=0.85, sigma=6, standard m=offset*(n-1), s=n/sigma
definitions.VIDYA: Chande VIDYA 20/40, alpha=2/(n+1)*|CMO_n|/100, CMO length=line length
definitions.FRAMA: Ehlers FRAMA 20/40 on median price (H+L)/2, half-window fractal dimension, alpha=exp(-4.6*(D-1)) clipped [0.01,1]
definitions.KAMA: frozen benchmark, Kaufman adaptive MA 20/40, fast=2 slow=30, ER length=line length (identical to Tournament I)
